title: Lost Mary Nera15K Mango Peach Papaya Prefilled Vape Pods
description: The Mango Peach Papaya Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pod layers three tropical fruits for a rich, sun-soaked flavour. Smooth Mango lays the foundation, joined by the delicate sweetness of Peach and the exotic, juicy lift of Papaya. The result is a bright, fruit-filled vape with plenty of depth. Each pack includes one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a 15ml Refill Pod that automatically keeps the pod topped up. This system provides up to 15,000 puffs depending on usage, with no need for refilling or coil changes. With a 0.6ohm mesh coil built in, the pod delivers full-bodied flavour and smooth vapour from beginning to end. Designed exclusively for the Lost Mary Nera30K Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill pod into place and continue vaping. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging and protective film. 2. Separate the 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container. 3. Push the refill container into the pod until it clicks securely. 4. Attach the pod to your Nera30K device and remove the silicone plug from the mouthpiece. 5. Vape and enjoy. Once the e-liquid runs out, simply swap in a new Nera15K pod pack from a selection of 20 incredible Lost Mary flavour profiles.
